cases.question: 2025年Orders中研发部的ApprovedAmount合计是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(ApprovedAmount) FROM Orders WHERE Department='研发部' AND ApprovedDate>='2025-01-01' AND ApprovedDate<'2026-01-01'

cases.question: 那支持部呢？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(ApprovedAmount) FROM Orders WHERE Department='支持部' AND ApprovedDate>='2025-01-01' AND ApprovedDate<'2026-01-01'

cases.question: 先从Orders按Department查询2025年ApprovedAmount合计最高的部门，再根据查出的部门检索该部门采购审批规则，并保留来源。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT Department,SUM(ApprovedAmount) FROM Orders WHERE ApprovedDate>='2025-01-01' AND ApprovedDate<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY Department ORDER BY SUM(ApprovedAmount) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 换个主题，2025年WarrantyRequests的RefundedAmount合计是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(RefundedAmount) FROM WarrantyRequests WHERE RequestDate>='2025-01-01' AND RequestDate<'2026-01-01'

cases.question: 按退款核算说明中的每笔退款核算额公式，用WarrantyRequests中2025年的RefundedAmount合计和RequestId记录计数计算每笔退款核算额，不沿用采购部门筛选。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(RefundedAmount)*1.0/COUNT(RequestId) FROM WarrantyRequests WHERE RequestDate>='2025-01-01' AND RequestDate<'2026-01-01'
